name: vol_clustering_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, GARCH-style volatility clustering is especially pronounced at 5-second resolution because institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms submit bursts of child orders when executing large directional trades — each burst creates a high-vol bar which triggers further algorithmic participation, compounding volatility for 15-45 consecutive seconds. When a GARCH(1,1) conditional sigma rank exceeds the 75th percentile for 3+ consecutive 5-second bars AND price simultaneously breaks above/below the prior 100 seconds of closes, the order flow imbalance is almost certainly driven by a large institutional order still executing — not a noise spike. The EMA alignment (8-bar over 21-bar = 40s over 105s) confirms multi-scale momentum, reducing the probability of fading a transient spike.
core_signal_oneliner: GARCH(1,1) sigma in 75th percentile for 3+ consecutive bars with 100s breakout and multi-scale EMA alignment
